title: Common regular representative for a supplied derived reduction
statement: Let ell be prime and W a scheme. Given the derived categories of integral pro-etale sheaves and strict p-adic systems and any simultaneous derived reduction D of scalar extension [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], every object K of the integral derived category has a representative P with Q(P) isomorphic to K, all ell^(n+1) multiplication maps monic in each degree, and the supplied counit D.epsilon(P) invertible.

source.place: Steps (2) and (3), the common two-term resolution and its (ell,1) transition.

proof.text: Resolve each complex by flat-term complexes using the proved generic flat-resolution theorem. Flatness makes nonzero integer multiplication monic, and exact scalar extension preserves these monomorphisms.

Apply the existing resolving-class construction to simultaneous ordinary reduction. The multiplication short exact sequences imply preservation of quasi-isomorphisms between regular representatives. Its counit computes the derived functor on them.

The counit-compatible natural isomorphism between left derived functors transfers invertibility to the supplied D. Choose a regular resolution of a representative of K and localize its quasi-isomorphism.

theorem diagonal_reduction_resolution (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
    (K : DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W)) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (DiagonalAb W) ℤ) (_e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Mono (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (P.X i))) ∧ IsIso (D.ε.app P)
